tiers.label: Technical
tiers.conclusion_rule: Can support high-confidence findings when internally consistent and corroborated.

tiers.label: Operational
tiers.conclusion_rule: Strong institutional signal; can support findings with corroboration.

tiers.label: Eyewitness
tiers.conclusion_rule: Lead only unless corroborated by T1/T2 evidence.

tiers.label: Secondary
tiers.conclusion_rule: Lowest weight; cannot confirm findings alone.

global_rules: Every finding must expose source-tier composition.
T3/T4 evidence cannot produce a high-confidence conclusion without T1/T2 corroboration.
Blocking contradictions cap confidence at medium until resolved.
Missing provenance prevents promotion above low confidence.
